result.summary: The page is generally structured correctly, but several horizontal carousel items and lower content appear visibly cut off, and a loading indicator remains over a restaurant image.

issues.description: The rightmost restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” row is clipped by the viewport, including its image, title (“Trattoria Piccol...”), and delivery price. The text is cut off without a clear truncation treatment.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have appropriate end padding and truncate long titles with an ellipsis or wrap them within the card rather than letting content be hard-clipped.

issues.description: The category chip row has a partially visible chip at the far right edge, which looks abruptly cropped.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding to the horizontal category list or use a deliberate partial-peek carousel treatment with enough visible space to indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image while the rest of the restaurant card is already visible, making the listing appear unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image has loaded, or show a consistent image placeholder/skeleton until loading is complete.

issues.description: The next popular restaurant card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation area at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the fixed navigation height so the final visible cards can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
